prompt: Create a high-fantasy magical staff item icon on a clean white or transparent background, isolated with no shadow box or scenery. The staff is a long diagonal wand running from the lower left to the upper right, made of dark twisted carved wood wrapped in elegant curling gold vines and filigree. At the top is an ornate gold crescent-moon frame with engraved swirls, leaf-like gold fittings, and a brilliant translucent purple five-point star crystal set inside the crescent, glowing with bright lens-flare highlights and faceted gemstone reflections. Include exactly 8 visible purple gem elements: 1 large star crystal in the crescent, 1 dangling faceted teardrop crystal on a fine gold chain, 1 round orb gemstone at the bottom pommel, 1 round gem below the crescent, 2 oval inlaid gems along the shaft, 1 small star-shaped gem on the shaft, and 1 tiny oval gem near the lower shaft. Include exactly 5 visible gold star ornaments: 1 at the crescent tip, 1 small star on the left of the main crystal, 1 small star on the right edge of the crescent, 1 tiny star above the dangling crystal, and 1 star setting on the staff shaft. Use a polished game asset / RPG inventory icon style with crisp edges, rich gold metallic highlights, deep brown wood grain, luminous magical sparkle, and highly detailed fantasy ornamentation. Center the full object with generous empty space around it, no text, no hands, no character, no background pattern. The item should feel like a celestial wizard staff with luxurious golden craftsmanship and radiant amethyst magic.

promptZh: 创建一个高奇幻风格的魔法权杖物品图标，背景为纯白或透明，独立呈现，无阴影框或场景。权杖呈长条状，从左下角向右上角倾斜，由深色扭曲的雕刻木材制成，缠绕着优雅的卷曲金藤和金丝装饰。顶部是一个华丽的金色新月形框架，带有雕刻的漩涡纹路、叶状金饰，以及一颗镶嵌在新月内部、光芒四射的半透明 紫色 五角星水晶，带有明亮的镜头光晕和多面宝石反射效果。包含精确的 8 个可见紫色宝石元素：新月内 1 颗大型星形水晶、金链上 1 颗悬挂的多面水滴状水晶、底部柄端 1 颗圆形宝石、新月下方 1 颗圆形宝石、杖身上 2 颗椭圆形镶嵌宝石、杖身上 1 颗小型星形宝石，以及下杖身附近 1 颗微型椭圆形宝石。包含精确的 5 个可见金色星形装饰：新月尖端 1 个、主水晶左侧 1 个小星、新月右边缘 1 个小星、悬挂水晶上方 1 个微型星，以及杖身上 1 个星形底座。采用精致的游戏素材 / RPG 物品栏图标风格，边缘清晰，具有丰富的金色金属高光、深棕色木纹、发光的魔法闪烁以及高度细腻的奇幻装饰。将完整物体居中，周围留有充足的空白，无文字、无手部、无角色、无背景图案。该物品应呈现出 星空法师权杖 的质感，展现奢华的黄金工艺与璀璨的紫水晶魔法。
